contentCenter.title: Content center
contentCenter.description: Enable Workshop, creator features, and Workshop transfers. Turning this off pauses Workshop tasks and preserves tasks and files; resume manually after re-enabling. GitHub downloads are unaffected.
contentCenter.creator: Creator center
contentCenter.officialServicesHelp: Enable account services, weekly mutation online calibration, and Workshop. Turning this off clears local sign-in; sign in again after re-enabling. Feature preferences, local features, and GitHub downloads are preserved. Analytics has an independent switch and falls back to anonymous statistics when left enabled.
contentCenter.weeklyCalibrationHelp: Use official services to calibrate local weekly mutation results. Local data and rules remain available when this is off.
